status.elsewhere: Phone active in another tab — close that tab to use it here

audio.title: Call audio
audio.missing: The selected device is not plugged in. Check the active device under Call connection.
audio.outputUnsupported: This browser cannot choose the speaker. Use Chrome or Edge, or change the output in your system settings.

missed.busyToast: Missed call from {name} during your call

disposition.title: Call outcome
disposition.dismissBody: The call will stay unclassified in the log and the client record will not be updated.

errors.mic_fallback: The selected microphone is unavailable. This call is using your system's default microphone.
errors.mic_disconnected: Your microphone disconnected. Switching to the system's default microphone — check that the other person can hear you.
errors.playback_blocked: Your browser blocked call audio. Tap or click in the app to enable sound.
errors.hold_unavailable: The call cannot change hold state yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.mic_denied: Microphone access denied. Allow the microphone in your browser settings and try again.
errors.mic_prompt: Allow microphone access in the browser prompt to start the call.
errors.mic_timeout: Could not access the microphone (no response). Check the mic permission and try again.
errors.mic_unavailable: No usable microphone. Connect or allow a microphone, then try again.
errors.dial_timeout: The other end did not respond to the call. Please try again shortly.
errors.ice_failed: The browser could not set up call audio (network blocked). Try another network or disable your VPN.
errors.not_registered: The line is not connected. Check the line status and try again.
errors.already_in_call: A call is already in progress.
errors.busy: The other party's line is busy.
errors.call_failed: The call failed. Please try again shortly.
errors.connect_failed: Could not connect to the phone service.
errors.not_configured: Phone not configured — contact your administrator.
errors.save_failed: Could not save the outcome. Please try again.
errors.log_failed: The call could not be logged. Record the outcome on the client page.

callsPage.title: My calls
callsPage.subtitle: Your call activity — today and the last few days
callsPage.resultsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No calls} one {# call} other {# calls}}

empty.title: No calls for this period
empty.hint: Dial with the phone button at the bottom of the screen — your calls will show up here.

quality.title: Call connection
quality.scope: Measures the connection between this browser and the phone service. The recipient's carrier and device are not measured. Missing measurements are shown as unavailable.
quality.micInterrupted: The microphone has stopped delivering audio. Check your headset and microphone permissions.
quality.networkAdvice: Audio may break up. Check your connection and pause large uploads. Avoid switching networks during the call.
quality.captureAdvice: For clear speech, use a wired headset, select its microphone, and keep it near your mouth. Speakerphone and Bluetooth can add echo or reduce clarity.
